disqualifier.note: Single stored 2-state marker (independent vs dependent). No sibling boolean and no payload whose presence it restates; text is always present. PatentClaim already encodes the same distinction as a tagged union with claimReferences only on dependent. Both true and false are constructed (entity example, domain test, IrToLaw spike). Leftover after every S.Boolean/BoolKeyDefaultFalse cluster in this lane.

filedSameDayAsClosingAction is an independently observed same-day comparison, not a duplicate of closingActionMailingDate presence. Documented constructor and candor fixtures write the flag false with date none; no in-repo producer writes the flag true, so a same-day-implies-date implication is unproven. Distinct from the inventoried five-flag observation cluster.
